search_window.basis: Last reported completed supplementary recall watch through current check; gap extended because intervening checks were not established.

coverage_notes.role: Supplementary recall watch only; production national Care Line collection remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.search_coverage: US states and territories; hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, rural service loss, dialysis, oncology, primary care, ambulance/air medical base, reopenings, CMS provider and CLIA notices.
coverage_notes.outcome_detail: No independently confirmed new qualifying care-access change published within the observed period among searched sources.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Older previously reported service changes, Canadian services, proposed-only actions, holiday operating schedules, ownership stories without service change, news recaps and unspecific reopening intentions.
coverage_notes.constraints: No approval, publication, production-collector intervention, schedule alteration, or task disabling.
